name: TH Analytica
description: A methodology for analysing AI readiness, AI visibility, agent readiness and governance across digital assets and, where relevant, physical places.

name: Semantic Friction
description: The loss of meaning or clarity when AI systems misunderstand or misrepresent content.

name: Agent Readiness
description: The degree to which an organisation's public information, permissions and processes are prepared for AI-assisted interpretation and human-approved actions.

name: AI Actionability
description: Structuring information so systems can identify possible actions and their constraints without implying autonomous execution.

name: Physical AI Governance
description: Context-specific governance for AI-capable devices, wearables, sensors or agents operating in physical places, assessed through Policy, Context, Enforcement, Responsibility and Audit.

name: Digital House Rules
description: Machine-readable, context-specific usage rules for physical places or zones. The term is descriptive and does not imply a universal technical standard.

name: Thomas Hullin
description: Founder of TH Analytica and creator of the AI readiness and visibility framework.
